EC-RAFT: Automated Generation of Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria through Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning
record.reason: Formal long-paper type awaiting independent reconciliation. Core clinical research NLP: EC-RAFT generates complete clinical-trial inclusion/exclusion criteria from trial titles and descriptions with retrieval-augmented fine-tuning and intermediate reasoning. All main data are 267,347 ClinicalTrials.gov trials split into train/validation/test; evaluation compares generated criteria to registry references via BERTScore and clinical-relevance matching, plus physician review of 302 criterion pairs from 20 trials. This supports clinical-trial design, not general QA with a medical subset. The paper explicitly requires human expert validation and does not establish deployment safety. Its abstract's judge score (1.66) differs from final Table 2 (1.7150 for Gemini-reasoning EC-RAFT), so no numerical superiority claim is propagated as independently verified.

record.title: DeepBranchTracer: A Generally-Applicable Approach to Curvilinear Structure Reconstruction Using Multi-Feature Learning
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Computer Vision III
record.reason: Complete official abstract reviewed. DeepBranchTracer develops a general 2D/3D branch tracing framework. Its real studies include Massachusetts road networks, DRIVE/CHASE retinal vessels, DIADEM neurons and prepared fMOST-VTA mouse-brain stacks. Core ablations use fMOST-VTA and biological reconstruction receives detailed analysis, but roads have a dedicated quantitative comparison, qualitative figure and discussion as part of the central generic curvilinear-reconstruction claim. Biomedical-primary versus co-central general study remains uncertain; retain scope pending rather than decide by dataset count.
